items.title: Amazon’s new Kindle Colorsoft is a premium e-reader with a premium price
items.author: Aisha Malik
items.content: <article>The latest model is lighter and thinner than its predecessor and features an edge-to-edge display. But if you already own the first-generation Colorsoft, there’s little reason to upgrade. </article>

items.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
items.author: Marina Temkin, Dominic-Madori Davis
items.content: <article>Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.</article>

items.title: US government grounds all flights across the United States ‘due to extraordinary circumstances’
items.author: Zack Whittaker
items.content: <article>A spokesperson for the FAA told TechCrunch that it issued the ground stop "following communication issues impacting multiple Air Route Traffic Control Centers," which manage the airspace across the United States.</article>

items.title: This young startup wants to power floating data centers with the ocean’s heat, and investors are already on board
items.author: Tim De Chant
items.content: <article>Drogue is harvesting heat from the ocean to power data centers on floating vessels. The first prototype should be bobbing around the ocean, crunching bits, in less than two years.</article>

items.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
items.author: Julie Bort
items.content: <article>LangChain now claims 7,000 customers of its model and platform agnostic agent management tool LangSmith. </article>

items.title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China’s most powerful AI models — uh-oh, Jensen!
items.author: Tim Fernholz
items.content: <article>New research shows the most advanced AI models from China were trained on banned Nvidia chips.</article>

items.title: ChatGPT’s new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you
items.author: Sarah Perez
items.content: <article>ChatGPT Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out on users' behalf, starting with a limited rollout to U.S. Pro subscribers.</article>

items.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
items.author: Amanda Silberling
items.content: <article>Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia following an affair, which could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.</article>

items.title: Uber confirms hackers stole thousands of drivers’ license information in data breach
items.author: Zack Whittaker
items.content: <article>The ridesharing giant said drivers' license information stored by AI cloud company Fireworks AI was stolen during a security incident.</article>

items.title: ElevenLabs’ new app combines meeting note-taking and dictation for teams
items.author: Ivan Mehta
items.content: <article>ElevenAI is a new meeting notetaker and dictation app aimed at teams and enterprises.</article>

items.title: Microsoft’s latest email outage turned into a full-blown global cloud crisis
items.author: Zack Whittaker
items.content: <article>Microsoft's daylong outage began with Outlook and Teams and ended up taking much of the company's cloud services offline. Microsoft says it's gradually restoring service.</article>

items.title: Israel’s VCs see opportunity for challengers in Nvidia’s turmoil
items.author: Anna Heim
items.content: <article>Given Nvidia’s stronghold on AI and its importance in Israel, many in the country's startup ecosystem are worried about the impact of his departure.</article>

items.title: Jensen Huang didn’t show confidence in his successor, report says
items.author: Ivan Mehta
items.content: <article>Huang described Kress as a "deer in the headlights" during a meeting in summer.</article>

items.title: Democrats launch Nvidia investigation, write scathing letter on Huang’s ‘scheme’ with Trump
items.author: Julie Bort
items.content: <article>This Congressional investigation into Nvidia's China sales and its dealings with Trump is the second one, so far, since news of the alleged spy affair broke. </article>

items.title: Muse can now place calls to US businesses — if you pay
items.author: Sarah Perez
items.content: <article>Muse's AI can now place outbound calls to U.S. businesses — but it's not free. </article>

items.title: Nebius tests the neocloud playbook with $40 billion in planned spending
items.author: Rebecca Bellan
items.content: <article>Nebius plans to fund its $40 billion AI infrastructure expansion through customer prepayments and loans, even as delays at a Microsoft data center raise questions about its financing model.</article>

items.title: Jensen Huang was having a third affair, Reuters reports
items.author: Russell Brandom
items.content: <article>Reuters is withholding the name of the new employee linked to Huang, but says she is an employee of Nvidia.</article>

items.title: Google’s latest Search upgrade promises better answers to your most complicated questions
items.author: Sarah Perez
items.content: <article>Powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Google's AI Mode is getting better at understanding complex queries, surfacing relevant links, and delivering richer visual responses.</article>

items.title: Nectar launches an AI agent to automate creator discovery and outreach for brands
items.author: Lauren Forristal
items.content: <article>Nectar's new AI agent automates influencer marketing, helping brands discover creators, manage outreach and partnerships, and track campaign results.</article>

items.title: Jensen Huang’s exit puts Nvidia’s support for open source in question
items.author: Rebecca Bellan
items.content: <article>Jensen Huang’s resignation raises questions about Nvidia’s commitment to open source AI, including its Hugging Face acquisition, open-weight models, and advocacy against restrictions, as the company navigates a leadership transition.</article>
